entries.230e3869c25ae4b9: Its greatest feature is a platform in which media, EC and stores are linked around '@cosme', used by monthly users exceeding one-third of the domestic female population, and in which reviews and behavioral data accumulated since its founding are put to use in the business. Retail, which has points of contact with consumers, and marketing support, which uses those touchpoints and data for advertising and consulting aimed at cosmetics brands, are mutually linked. In April 2025, it established a specialized company for data-driven solutions and is strengthening its data-utilization structure, including AI review analysis tools.

entries.4e30045e217c36cb: Its vision is 'Creating a consumer-centered market'. With '@cosme' at its core, it has grown into a comprehensive platform for the cosmetics industry, encompassing not only media but also EC operation, store operation and staffing services, among others. It states that its greatest strength lies in its proprietary platform, in which media, EC and stores are linked around data. As issues to be addressed, it cites: strengthening and expanding the platform (deepening the use of accumulated data, expanding the customer base through linkage between EC and stores, strengthening information security systems, and creating new value through co-creation with AI); expanding the business into the broader BEAUTY area, such as inner care and aging care; rebuilding its overseas strategy with improving profitability as the top priority (establishing a Beauty economic zone centered on East Asia); and strengthening its management foundation through development of human resources, organization and governance.
